notes: Full audit of all 117 church coordinates against OpenStreetMap. Two were wrong and are corrected: Sacre-Coeur Beau-Bassin was pinned on the Montmartre chapel in Rose-Hill - a different church already in this corpus 39 m away - and moves 1.54 km to its own mapped building; Notre-Dame-de-la-Delivrande was at Cap Malheureux, 20 km from its stated town and 0.9 km from Notre-Dame-Auxiliatrice, and moves 18.6 km to the village of Notre Dame near Montagne Longue that the diocese page names. Two further coordinates were upgraded from approximate to the mapped church building: Saint-Odile Camp-Levieux (272 m) and Saint-Maurice Poste-de-Flacq (1.12 km). 23 rows changed, no schedule data touched. After the fix no two churches share a coordinate, none sit within 60 m of each other, and no town has sites scattered more than 10 km apart.
